info.title: Create Packages
info.description: Use this API to ship orders (purchase labels). This API is region specific to the US and JP. The shipping fee and delivery time is an estimate only and is based on the package dimensions and weight you provided. Based on the package attributes, options listed below may differ from your shipping subscriptions.

post.description: Use this API to ship orders (purchase labels). This API is region specific to the US and JP. The shipping fee and delivery time is an estimate only and is based on the package dimensions and weight you provided. parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

ship_type.description:
1:All the products in one order are shipped in one package with one tracking number
  2:Partical products in one parent order are shipped in multiple packages with multiple tracking numbers
  3:All the products in multiple orders are shipped in one package with one tracking number.

order_id.description:
TikTok Shop order ID.
If ship_type=0&1,This is a required field;If ship_type=2,we will not use

order_line_id.description:
List of order line item IDs.
If ship_type=2,This is a required field;If ship_type=1&3,we will not use this field

sub_item_id.description:
Only for virtual bundle items,list of sub item ids.
If ship_type=2,This is a required field;If ship_type=1&3,we will not use this field

order_line_item.description:
List of order line item IDs.
If ship_type=2,This is a required field;If ship_type=1&3,we will not use this field

order_list_ids.description:
List of order line item IDs.
If ship_type=3,This is a required field;If ship_type=1&2,we will not use this field

length.description:
Package length.

The length, width, and height must be passed together.

width.description:
Package width.

The length, width, and height must be passed together.

height.description:
Package height.

The length, width, and height must be passed together.

unit.description:
The unit of measurement for the package dimensions.

Available values:
- `CM`
- `INCH`

shipping_service_id.description:
Specify the shipping service used. 
If not specified, use the default service obtained from [Get Eligible Shipping Service](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa6b2bace3e02b75dda4e).

value.description: The numerical value of the package weight.

unit.description:
The unit of measurement for the package weight.

Available values:
- `GRAM`
- `POUND`
